Squadron Leader Bhawana Kanth Becomes First Woman Fighter Combat Leader

Squadron Leader Bhawana Kanth has become the first woman to graduate from the Indian Air Force's (IAF) Tactics and Air Combat Development Establishment (TACDE) in Gwalior, commonly known as the IAF's "Top Gun" school. This achievement marks a significant milestone for women in combat roles within the IAF. The course is considered one of the toughest combat courses for fighter pilots.
